title: Felt his body turn to stone while linked to a craft that was shot
summary: Jordan tells of Felt his body turn to stone while linked to a craft that was shot, about unspecified at undisclosed area near directed energy weapons, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: undisclosed area near directed energy weapons

tellings.quote: it felt as if my body was actually turning to stone.

plain: A man named Jordan, who told podcast host Jesse Michels that he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, says he was once mentally linked to a craft when it was shot at, somewhere near directed energy weapons, meaning weapons that fire focused beams of energy. He says that in that moment it felt as if his body was actually turning to stone. If true, it would mean someone used people as a living link to these craft, and that the people felt it when the craft was hit.
